title: Saronic news card
description: A news card on a slate band: a hairline-framed half with a mono caption and a lime status dot at the top and a 40px headline, short paragraph and lime external-link button at the bottom, beside a photo of the same height (4px outer radius). Phones stack the text over a 4:3 or 16:9 photo.
notes: media is the photo; empty it is a placeholder
name: saronic-news

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: the mono caption at the top of the card ("News")

props.name: body
props.description: one or two sentences under it

props.name: cta
props.type: { label: ReactNode; href: string; icon?: any; external?: boolean; }

props.name: media
props.description: the story's photo; empty it is a placeholder

props.name: mobileAspect
props.description: the photo's shape on phones, under the text: 4:3 or a wide 16:9
